title: A preliminary randomized clinical trial comparing diode laser and scalpel periosteal incision during implant surgery: impact on postoperative morbidity and implant survival
authors: Shahnaz A, Jamali R, Mohammadi F, Khorsand A, Moslemi N, Fekrazad R. Lasers Med Sci. 2018; 33(1):19-25.[Epub 2017].
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “We did not find any detrimental effect of laser incision on the implant survival within 6 months of loading. *Study refers to Bone protect membrane, which is a private label of Jason® membrane” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
